label: Print shop (hero -> framed print -> order)
description: The relay beat after desktop-stage: it STARTS on desktop-stage's last frame (the same Safari window at left 0.015, top 0.144, width 0.969 of the frame, the same hero box and silk stage). At scroll_at the page scrolls: the landing copy rises away, a product card rises in, and the hero MORPHS into a framed print on it -- the photo shrinks into a portrait while a white MAT and a thin frame MOLDING grow out of its edge; the product panel (title, description, frame swatches, size segmented control, price) arrives on the right and the camera pushes onto the card; at cta_at the nav's black Order button FLIES DOWN and becomes the full-width 'Order print'. The cursor clicks a frame swatch at frame_at (the new colour PAINTS along the molding, 0.25 s), a size at size_at (the segment slides), and 'Order print' at order_at; from zoom_at the camera pushes onto the button (zoom 1.5) and the ONE black shape morphs through its states (default: spinner -> check Ordered -> Printing n% with a progress line -> On its way / today with a van on a route -> a black done circle with a check drawn in). HANDOFF: the done circle ENDS at the done geometry in frame coordinates -- centre (0.5, 0.62), diameter 0.12 -- ready for a flood. All *_at are scene seconds and default to `at` + the reference offset (scroll 0.25, cta 1.0, frame 1.25, size 1.75, order 2.1, ordered 2.5, printing 2.9-3.7, route 4.0-4.5, done 4.75; ~5 s). Example: {"at":16.5,"image":"/assets/astronaut.jpg","site":{"brand":"develop","cta":"Order"},"product":{"title":"the print","desc":"archival pigment on cotton rag. framed by hand, ready to hang.","frames":[{"name":"oak","color":"#c9a27a"},{"name":"black","color":"#111"},{"name":"white","color":"#f4f3ef"}],"sizes":["30×40","50×70","70×100"],"price":"$129","cta":"Order print"},"pick_frame":1,"pick_size":2,"cursor_from":[0.735,0.71]}.

image.label: The photo (URL) -- the same one desktop-stage dropped as its hero

at.label: Scene second the beat starts (default 0); every *_at defaults relative to it

stage.label: The backdrop, as desktop-stage: silk | none

site.label: The landing page it starts on (same shape as desktop-stage's site)

pick_frame.label: The swatch the cursor picks (index, default 1 = black)

pick_size.label: The size the cursor picks (index, default 2 = 70×100)

states.label: The order button's morph, in order (scene seconds)

to.label: progress/route: when the bar or the van arrives

right.label: route: the grey right-hand word (default today)

scroll_at.label: The scroll + hero -> framed print morph (default at+0.25)

cta_at.label: The nav button flies down into 'Order print' (default at+1.0)

frame_at.label: Click on the swatch; the colour paints along the molding (default at+1.25)

ordered_at.label: 'Ordered' (default at+2.5; used by the default states)

done_at.label: The done circle (default at+4.75; used by the default states)

zoom_at.label: The camera push onto the button starts (default order_at-0.1, 0.6 s)

zoom.label: That push's scale (default 1.5); the done circle still lands on (0.5, 0.62) d 0.12

zoom_card.label: The first push onto the product card at cta_at (default 1.25)

stage_zoom.label: desktop-stage's zoom (default 1.7) -- sets the starting window size

cursor_from.label: Cursor start [x, y], frame fractions (default [0.735, 0.71] = desktop-stage's cursor_to)

cursor_to.label: Cursor rest at the end [x, y], frame fractions (default [0.72, 0.8])

cursor_scale.label: Cursor size at the start relative to the base (default sqrt(stage_zoom) = desktop-stage's end size)
